finalText:
Build is clean. The two real bugs were API mismatches from the bump:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — the new bundler changed the options shape from `retries` to `retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, so the strict check needed to handle that case.

The 8 remaining warnings are just deprecation notices from the bundler itself (deprecated Node APIs in your dependencies) — those are noise, not errors. The link stage passed, bundle emitted, exit 0.
